lessons.scene_snapping: author_lib snaps a scene start to the largest stage change within +-15 frames; if the true scene boundary has <1000 stage px (props shrinking into a new scene), merge the scenes instead (xrNPr3YrWdw S07)
lessons.cadence_phase: build_video_tables now reports a measured 24->30 fps conform when duplicate frames share one phase mod 5 (xrNPr3YrWdw, wo71JwXSYIs)

lessons.sheet_frames: Event-sheet cells are native frame numbers (verified 1:1 with gray.npy), but hand-read onsets from sheets can be off by a few frames; confirm exact pop frames with the pixel/colour series (measure_color_area.py or stage px) before citing them (zkeA5cH9nyM '66.7%' f1058)
lessons.full_bleed_workflow: Full-bleed: prep_full.sh -> bands.json add auto_fill + depth_label -> author_review.py via author_lib (stage [0,1]); measure camera with rows e.g. 0.05:0.55, colour blink with measure_color_area.py; unquoted loop vars do not split in zsh (use ${=args})
lessons.fill_small: Author.fill_small(172) adds UNRESOLVED_CHANGE rows for detected changes >=172 stage px that no authored event covers; call it just before A.write() in full-bleed videos with many small events (ud1ESmogrFY)
lessons.aggregate_audio: scripts/aggregate_audio.py computes the audio table (voiced %, wpm, phrase rate, pauses, levels, flux at cuts, cut-to-word offsets) over all validated videos into evidence/audio_aggregate.json
lessons.full_mode_qa: In full mode QA does not require every small (<0.8 %) change to be attributed: A.fill_small is optional there; a cut-like event placed on a frame with 0 stage px (e.g. a removal one frame earlier) fails every_hard_cut_has_large_stage_change, so confirm the frame from the px series
lessons.dash_ids: Video ids starting with '-' (-WJDfT-MwmY, -Vr8JhCIv08): argparse scripts (event_sheets.py, make_sheet.py) need options first and `-- <vid> <root>`; build_video_tables.py, write_review.py and measure_*.py take positionals and must NOT get `--`; measure_motion.py/measure_color_area.py take rows and segments as bare args (`0.0:0.5`, `640:722,1270:1312`), not `rows=...`
lessons.stale_caption_files: If prep_banded.sh was run to peek at a layout and the video is then analysed in full mode, delete videos/<id>/auto/CAPTION_EVENTS_AUTO.csv and CAPTION_WORD_EVENTS.csv before build_video_tables.py, otherwise caption offsets are computed from a band that does not exist (m8NC4L8hmeE, fixed 2026-10-20)
lessons.fill_small_cut_duplicates: A.fill_small(172) also adds UNRESOLVED rows for cut frames that build_video_tables later turns into HARD_CUT_REPLACE; drop UNRESOLVED rows whose text mentions CUT/BIG_POP and that sit within 2 frames of a scene start (see videos/m8NC4L8hmeE/review/author_review.py), otherwise events and the unresolved share are inflated
lessons.coverage_gaps: QA fails if any stage-active frame (>=172 px) is outside every authored event: slow slides, continuous character loops (~500-1200 px per frame for dozens of frames), slow drifts (bbox moves 0.05 of frame height over ~146 frames) and typed-caption starts need an event spanning those frames
lessons.clip_cadence: Third-party clip inserts update every 3rd frame (10 fps) on 30 fps files (alternating 2/3 on 24 fps); measure by mean abs diff inside the clip region and list update frames; op VIDEO_CLIP_INSERT (mclass INDET) was added to build_video_tables.py TAX
lessons.tracker_limits: measure_motion camera saturates for fast zooms (per-frame scale cap ~1.03) and returns net 0 px when a chart line reveals while the page moves: report such moves as DIRECTLY_OBSERVED without geometry
lessons.read_along_pans: measure_motion.py camera on a text page returns per-frame dx_px; run-length encode curves[].dx_px to get constant-velocity passes and returns (2EZzwupIa80); its scale_fit/pan_*_fit are meaningless when net scale is ~1.0 or the page repeats
lessons.small_stage_layout: layout_profile can show activity only in rows 0.37-0.72 with cuts(>=20%)=0 (JsK53moCyZA): use full mode, hard cuts are changes of 6-31 % of the band; build_video_tables accepts them (>=1000 px)
lessons.caption_lead_frame: At some cuts the caption block clears one frame before the picture; check px(f-1) at each hard cut and log a CAPTION_CHUNK_CHANGE in the previous scene

longform_procedure.why_separate: Hand-authoring every event (Short procedure) would mean thousands of events per video. Long-form uses a full automated pass plus hand-authored, seeded sampling windows. Findings from windows are SAMPLED, never universal; always state "windows X s of T s".
longform_procedure.keep_separate: Long-form aggregates go into their own files (e.g. LONGFORM_*.csv). Do NOT merge with the 38-Short aggregates until both layouts are labelled; 16:9 layout is a new class. Never mix Casual Economics or What If evidence.
longform_procedure.start_gate: LF-0 first: five-hour usage < 90 % and weekly < 95 % (get_usage). Re-check between videos. Checkpoint, commit and push at five-hour >=90 % / weekly >=95 %, or context nearly full.

steps: LF-0 preflight: usage check; confirm source file and SHA256 against SOURCE_MEDIA_INVENTORY.csv (canonical row, Video_ID column); read PRIOR_RESEARCH_COVERAGE row; only one writer on the branch (git status clean, no other session running).
LF-1 decode: ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough to gray .npy in the local-evidence dir (outside Git); store frame count vs inventory; videos > 20k frames decode in chunks. Original MP4 is read-only.

LF-2 full automated pass over ALL frames: complete hard-cut list, pixel-delta series, scene count, static-frame share, cuts/min, events/min; fps cadence phase (24->30 repeated frame) where measurable; per-segment layout class (row profile) because long-form may switch layouts.

LF-3 sampling plan (write it to videos/<id>/review/WINDOWS.json BEFORE looking at content): first 60 s, last 60 s, plus N 45-s windows by fixed seed: top-20 % and bottom-20 % event density and 3 random. Record seed and window-seconds / total-seconds.

LF-4 hand-authored forensics inside windows only, same tables and rules as Shorts (scene timeline, motion events with easing fits filtered to net scale >= 5 %, colour-area emphasis, assets, caption words); outside windows rows are marked AUTOMATED_ONLY, never invented.

LF-5 audio and narration: Whisper small.en over the full audio (uncertified), measured loudness / voiced share / pauses; narration-to-visual alignment inside windows; story structure map in 60-90 s segments from ASR + cut density. Never claim to have listened.

LF-6 QA and commit: every frame belongs to an automated segment; every window frame covered by an event or marked; QA.json status VISUAL_FORENSICS_SAMPLED_AUDIO_LISTENING_BLOCKED; depth label LF-SAMPLED; update STATUS.json (move id to videos_complete_longform, not videos_complete), commit and push per video; record usage cost per video in this block.
